Mechanically inclined. Solid working knowledge of hand tools and machining processes is essential. Must have previous training and experience in performing setups, edits, and inspections and have the ability to perform in a competent manner.
Must be experienced with machine shop inspection tools (i.e calipers, micrometers, etc). Knowledge of CAD/CAM software (Creo, Pro-M) or the ability to learn.
Some computer experience essential. Must possess a reasonable degree of hand-eye coordination and dexterity in order to effectively utilize tools required for the job. Physical ability to lift up to 60 lb. Physical ability to work extended hours in a standing position. May be required to become forklift operator certified. Sense of urgency, accuracy and attention to detail is essential. Individual must be self motivated with the initiative to follow through on matters. Effective communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to work well with management and staff. Solid judgment with demonstrated ability to remain calm and work well under pressure. Patience, flexibility and a sense of humor are a must. Strong leadership ability in support of a team environment.
